verdicts.note: The alloy compositions are correct, but AlCo0.5Cr0.5FeNi is not equiatomic across all five elements; Co and Cr each have half the nominal fraction of Al, Fe, and Ni.

Most findings are supported. However, the paper explicitly describes the 600 °C grain-boundary sigma phase as Cr-rich, not as enriched in Cr, Fe, and Co; that three-element enrichment is stated for the 1000 °C FCC grain-boundary phase.

The proposed role of positive Fe-Cr, Co-Cr, and Ni-Cr mixing enthalpies is supported, but the paper does not attribute the refined decomposition at lower temperature specifically to reduced atomic mobility.
